decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - 1.	The proposal to change the corridor from C3 (residential) to A1 (retail) has not demonstrated that it would not adversely impact on the character and appearance of the Thorney Hedge Conservation Area. The proposal has therefore not demonstrated compliance with Policies ENV-B.2.2 (Conservation Areas), ENV-B.1.1 (New Development) and S.4.2 (Shop Front Design) of the Unitary Development Plan.

Condition : 2 - 2.	The proposal to change the corridor from C3 (residential) to A1 (retail) has not provided sufficient access for the residential properties at first and second floor level. The proposal is contrary to Policies ENV B.1.1 (New Development), H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations), S.4.7 (Access to Upper Floors) of the Unitary Development Plan.
description: Change of use of  the staircase at 393 from C3 to A1
